Lucario vs. Garchomp: Who wins?

Of 100 simulated battles (level 50, standard sets), Lucario wins 0 and Garchomp 100.

Assumptions: level 50, no items, neutral nature, last four level-up moves, Gen 9 mechanics, greedy AI on both sides.

WHY IT PLAYS OUT THIS WAY

Garchomp is faster than Lucario (122 vs. 110 Speed) and moves first.

Best answer of Lucario: Meteor Mash deals 31.7–37.7% of Garchomp's HP per hit.

Best answer of Garchomp: Bulldoze hits Lucario super effectively (×2) for 80–95.2% HP per hit.

Q&A

Garchomp. At level 50 Garchomp reaches 122 Speed, Lucario only 110 — so Garchomp moved first in every simulated battle.

Rarely. Of 100 simulated battles (level 50, standard sets), Garchomp wins 100 and Lucario only 0. Custom moves or items can change the picture — try it in the simulator above.
